title: fix(objectql): a currency field written as an object is refused with the bare-number lesson
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB3XVq26dCwy6GNva763uff5)_
Fixes #27236

Ruling-ref: 6464202770
Claim: 6468731037
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

The accept set does not move, only the message. Measured: the same four writes (an object, `'abc'`, `10`, an object on a `number` field) answer the same verdict and the same wire code before and after; only the first one's `message` changes. No authorable key, schema, type or export changes.

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么：** 货币字段的值写成对象 `{ value, currency }` 时，拒收码仍是 `invalid_number`，但提示改为说明：货币值是裸数字（ADR-0104），币种在字段的 `currencyConfig` 里声明，dynamic 模式下取组织默认币种。
- **为什么改：** #27182 退役了 `{ value, currency }` 这个旧形状，AI 作者和老代码仍会这样写；以前只看到「必须是数字」，不知道该怎么改。
- **风险与回滚：** 只换提示文字，错误码、错误字段、接受与拒收的集合都不变；回滚 = revert 本 PR。
- **先看：** `packages/objectql/src/validation/record-validator.ts`（数值分支那一行 `fail`）、`packages/spec/src/system/validation-message.ts`（四种语言的新句子）。
- **两分钟验证：** `pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql exec vitest run src/validation/record-validator.test.ts -t 27236` → 7 个用例全绿。
- **需要您做的：** 无，席位落地。

## What changes

- **`@objectstack/objectql`, the record validator's numeric arm** (`record-validator.ts`, `isJudgedNumberType`). When the field is `currency` and the value is a plain object (an object literal or a null-prototype record; never an array, a `Date` or another class instance), the `invalid_number` refusal renders the catalog message `invalid_number_currency_object` instead of the plain `invalid_number` one. The code stays `invalid_number` and the error carries no new key, so no client contract moves. Everything else in the arm keeps the plain sentence.
- **`@objectstack/spec`, the validation-message catalog** (`system/validation-message.ts`). It gains `invalid_number_currency_object` in en, zh-CN, ja-JP and es-ES. **One message source:** the catalog owns the sentence and the validator passes only its key, so there is no second hand-written copy. A deployment can override it under `validation.field.invalid_number_currency_object`, as with every built-in message.
- **No default currency is named.** The sentence names no currency code and no symbol in any locale; it points at `currencyConfig` (the `fixed` mode's `defaultCurrency`) or, under `dynamic`, the tenant default (#27119 Q2 = X). A spec pin checks this in every locale.
- **The spec's `valueSchemaFor('currency')` arm is not touched.** The order asked for the sentence there only if `os validate` seed data reaches it. Measured: it does not (see Verification). That arm also lives in `packages/spec/src/data/field-value.zod.ts`, which PR #27233 edits, so leaving it alone is also what the serial constraint requires.
- **Serial constraint.** PR #27233 (#27182) is open on the currency surface. This PR edits none of its 26 files (file lists compared at #27233 head `c85e08be`). It lands after #27233.

## Tests

- `packages/objectql/src/validation/record-validator.test.ts`, a new `[#27236]` block, 7 cases:
  - `{ value: 10, currency: 'USD' }` on a dynamic-mode and on a fixed-mode currency field, on insert and on update, is refused as exactly `[{ field, code: 'invalid_number', message: LESSON, label }]`, the same keys as before.
  - The lesson is not the plain sentence, starts with "Amount is a currency amount: write it as a bare number", and names `currencyConfig`.
  - A bare number passes.
  - CONTROL: `'abc'` on a currency field keeps the plain sentence.
  - CONTROL: `[10]` on a currency field keeps the plain sentence.
  - CONTROL: an object on a `number` field keeps the plain sentence, because the lesson is currency-only.
- `packages/spec/src/system/validation-message.test.ts`, a new block: every locale names `{ value, currency }`, `currencyConfig`, `defaultCurrency`, `fixed`, `dynamic` and ADR-0104, and no locale spells a three-letter currency code or a currency symbol. The existing completeness pins (every locale defines every key, every template names `{{label}}`) cover the new key.

## Acceptance notes

- `os validate` does not judge seed record values against their field type. A seed row giving a currency field `{ value: 10, currency: 'USD' }` passes validation (exit 0) and is only refused later, when the seed is written through the record validator. This is a separate finding, reported to the seat and not changed here.

## Verification

All readings below are on head `6d7035fe` (branch off `origin/main` `d745bb5e`).

<details><summary>The refusal before and after (objectql validator, field def with no label, so the label is the API name)</summary>

Before, on `origin/main` `d745bb5e`:

```text
currency  { value: 10, currency: 'USD' }  → invalid_number  "amount must be a number"
currency  (fixed, EUR) same object        → invalid_number  "amount must be a number"
currency  'abc'                           → invalid_number  "amount must be a number"
currency  10                              → PASS
number    { value: 10, currency: 'USD' }  → invalid_number  "amount must be a number"
```

After, on `6d7035fe`:

```text
currency  { value: 10, currency: 'USD' }  → invalid_number  "amount is a currency amount: write it as a bare number (ADR-0104), such as 10, not an object such as { value, currency }. A currency field declares its currency in currencyConfig: the fixed mode's defaultCurrency, or under the dynamic mode (the default) the tenant default currency"
currency  'abc'                           → invalid_number  "amount must be a number"
currency  10                              → PASS
number    { value: 10, currency: 'USD' }  → invalid_number  "amount must be a number"
```

The error object's keys are `field`, `code`, `message` and `label` in every row, before and after.
</details>

<details><summary>Does os validate seed data reach valueSchemaFor('currency')? No</summary>

`examples/app-todo`, temporarily given `budget: Field.currency({ label: 'Budget' })` and a seed row with `budget: { value: 10, currency: 'USD' }`, then `node packages/cli/bin/run.js validate` on `origin/main` `d745bb5e` (cli closure built). Result: `✓ Validation passed`, exit 0. The only line naming the field is the `field-no-consumers` warning, which lists `data[0].records[4].budget` as a carrier site, so the seed row was read and its value was not judged. `SeedRecordValueSchema` (`data/seed.zod.ts`) is `z.unknown()` apart from the seed-file claim. The temporary edits were restored with `git checkout HEAD --` and `git diff HEAD` was empty afterwards.
</details>

<details><summary>Ablation</summary>

With the fix committed, `node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` replaced `t === 'currency' && isPlainObjectValue(value) ?` with `false /* ablated-27236 */ ?` (anchor 1 → 0, marker 0 → 1, blob `f47f64b9` → `845a0720`), then ran `record-validator.test.ts`: **2 failed | 131 passed**, the two `refuses { value, currency } … with invalid_number and the lesson` cases. The restore confirmed blob equals HEAD and `git diff HEAD` empty. The objectql test imports the validator from `src`, so no rebuild was needed for that leg. A first attempt was a no-op and is not counted: its replacement text `undefined` already appeared in the file, and the tool refused it before running anything.
</details>

<details><summary>Package tests and typechecks (under os-verify-lock, each exit captured separately)</summary>

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec test`: exit 0, Test Files 743 passed (743), Tests 22265 passed, 1 todo.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec typecheck`: exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql test`: exit 0, Test Files 477 passed (477), Tests 8906 passed (8906).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql typecheck`: exit 0.
- Dogfood battery: not run (no `!` in the title, and `Clause-②` has no `(narrowing)` arm).
</details>

<details><summary>Derived gates: 82 derived, 81 run with exit 0, 1 NOT MEASURED</summary>

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 82 families. Each was run serially and recorded as `CMD :: exit N`, and `--ran` reconciled: **82 accounted, 81 run, 1 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN**.

- `pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads`: exit 3, PREREQUISITE NOT MET (it needs a full-repo build; only the cli and objectql closures were built). NOT MEASURED; CI runs it.
- `node scripts/check-plugin-teardown-shape.mjs --self-test`: exit 3 on the first run (the shallow clone lacked its pinned fixture commit), exit 0 after `git fetch origin 621a4876`.
- Every other derived family, including `check-adr-0087-registration --base origin/main`, `check-changeset-no-major`, `check-empty-changeset`, `check:doc-authoring`, `check:cross-package-test-inputs` and the spec `check:*` set, exited 0.
</details>
